title: Northlight KPI knapsack notes - Ada Sherman
body:
Context:
I want a compact, repeatable weekly ritual that treats my limited focus/time as a knapsack: choose the highest-value experiments that fit the week. This is a personal scratchpad — not an official OKR doc. It should help avoid chasing low-value noise and build a simple signal-to-effort ratio over a quarter.

Northstar objective (quarter): Improve product experiment throughput while preserving daily coding momentum and reducing context-switch waste.

Hypothesis (how I’ll know it works): If I can sustain 3 high-impact experiment cycles per 2-week sprint with >50% positive signal decisions, my throughput and quality metrics will improve without burnout.

Key Results (draft metrics):
- KR1: Increase validated experiments per quarter from 6 -> 12 (validated = either shipped or clear kill decision).
- KR2: Reduce weekly context-switches (interruptions >15m) from avg 9 -> <=5.
- KR3: Maintain weekly feature-PR median review time <= 48h.
- KR4: Keep personal focus score (self-rated) >= 7/10 for 75% of weeks.

Knapsack approach (decision framework):
- Items = potential experiments/tasks. Each item gets: value (expected impact 1-10), cost (hours), risk (low/med/high), dependencies.
- Pack items into the week until total hours <= capacity (capacity = 28 focused hours/week in practice).
- Prioritize by value-per-hour, then by dependency unblockers.

Example week (week of 2024-04-29):
Capacity: 28h focused (two deep blocks of 3 hours/day avg)
Candidate items:
  1) Rerank-prototype A/B (value 8, cost 10h, risk med)
  2) Latency micro-optim (value 5, cost 6h, risk low)
  3) Docs sketch for demo (value 3, cost 4h, risk low)
  4) Investigate infra error spike (value 6, cost 8h, risk high)
  5) Quick UX microcopy test (value 2, cost 2h, risk low)
Pack by value/hour: 1) 0.8, 4) 0.75, 2) 0.83, 3) 0.75, 5) 1.0 -> But 5 is low impact absolute.
Chosen pack: 1 (10h) + 2 (6h) + 5 (2h) + 3 (4h) = 22h (keeps buffer for interruptions). Drop infra error deep-dive (delegate initial triage to Ishaan).

Weekly check-in template (to fill in 10–15 min):
1) Wins this week (3 bullets)
2) Clear kills / learnings (what we decided not to ship and why)
3) Focus gap (where I lost time, actionable cause)
4) Pack next week (list with value/cost)
5) One experiment to escalate / request help for
6) Confidence (1-10) and energy note (short)

Retro notes (2024-04 retrospective highlights):
- Win: Completed two experiment cycles and documented decisions inline with PRs. That reduced rework in follow-ups.
- Miss: I did not protect deep blocks on Wednesday; meetings ate a 4h contiguous slot and killed momentum.
- Fix: Block 09:30–12:00 for deep work in calendar; label as Heads-down (no Zoom).

Mini-experiments to try next month:
- Time-boxed async updates: replace two 30m standups with a single async note and 10m triage on Friday.
- Focus timer nudges: 2x/day calendar-only timer to train the team that interruptions are okay unless tagged urgent.
- Lightweight rubric for quick kills: if an experiment costs <3h and expected impact <3 -> do or kill same day.

Personal commitment (this doc):
- Protect deep work blocks at least 4 days/week.
- Run knapsack packing on Friday afternoon for the following week (30 min).
- Track the three most important metrics in a one-line weekly log (Validated experiments | Focus score | Interruptions): e.g., "W21: 2 | 7 | 8"

Open questions / to decide:
- Should I formalize this into a lightweight Notion template? (Pros: repeatability; Cons: overhead)
- What’s the best way to capture interruptions automatically? (Consider calendar metadata or small Tallybot)

Quick log (sample, one-line per week):
- 2024-04-15: 1 | 6 | 9 => Missed deep blocks, delegated infra triage slow
- 2024-04-22: 2 | 7 | 6 => Good pack, shipped micro-optim
- 2024-04-29: 2 | 8 | 5 => Protected blocks, chose knapsack pack above

Next actions (this week):
- Draft a one-pager of the knapsack method to share with Ishaan and Marta (2h).
- Add Focus blocks to calendar and test async updates experiment (1h).
- Build a tiny tracker (sheet) with columns: week, validated_experiments, focus_score, interruptions (1h).

Notes to self: keep the method small — it should change behaviour, not become another ritual to maintain. Capture kills as carefully as wins (those are high-signal).

References/links: Confluence canvas for prioritization, current PR list, and small UX ticket JIRA-UX-451 for microcopy test.

——
End of scratchpad. Keep this intentionally messy; I will trim and convert to a Notion template only if the weekly log shows persistent improvement over 6 cycles.
